script: Moon dust is nothing like the dust on Earth. Without wind or water to wear it down, its grains are sharp and jagged. It clung to everything the Apollo astronauts brought inside. It scratched visors and clogged equipment. One astronaut even got hay fever-like symptoms from it. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
title: Moon Dust Is Sharp Like Glass #Moon #SpaceFacts #Shorts
